scope: Repair phased-floor dispatch, quantized floor propagation and full-surface MPOA/LEACE; implement explicitly budgeted batching and rounded-weight reuse.
regressions_seen_fail_before_fix: full-surface LEACE multiplied incompatible GQA matrices
Q4/Q5 generation omitted the requested floor
batch policy was not accepted or implemented
generation progress reread all records per answer
partial merged cache thrashed across sequential layers
interrupted replay changed original batch companions
standalone CLI parser did not expose generation controls
a backend silently dropping the floor was accepted
implemented: floors forwarded through phased wrappers, full search, baseline/finalist Q4/Q5 and standalone generate
floor and batch settings bound to pipeline and standalone answer identities
input-side MPOA row-norm restoration and correctly oriented LEACE left/right factors
shared budget admission using exact rendered prompt tokens, output reserve and padded batch size
HF left-padded batched generation with unpadded saved trajectories
bounded loopback concurrency and configured GGUF parallel slots without shrinking per-request context
per-answer durable batch output, immutable saved companions and original-cohort replay
same-device merged cache with one explicit byte budget, pinned admission, mutation invalidation and training bypass
linear answer-ledger scans rather than rereading the whole ledger after every prompt

defaults.note: No live GPU occupancy probe, batch-size guess or user VRAM allocation was applied. Both performance controls are explicit opt-in.

limits: GPU deliberately untouched while busy; new batching/cache B70 parity and throughput remain unmeasured.
Tests use tiny tensor arithmetic, explicit transport/model-generation fixtures and scheduling fixtures, not a new pretrained checkpoint ablation.
No superiority over Heretic or Abliterix is claimed.
The merged byte limit bounds persistent cache entries, not temporary workspaces, KV state or copies retained by external callers.
